# tools/export_x68k_midi_flac.py from the extracted MIDI's global loop.
# The source renders contain two complete passes and end at source_le.  A
# one-second CPS+ crossfade needs real continuation audio after pack_le, so the
# pack phase is shifted one second earlier: pack_ls/le = source_ls/le - 48000,
# rounded DOWN to the 32-sample ADX grid.  This preserves the measured period;
# the retained second-pass final second is blended against the corresponding
# first-pass final second.  Songs absent from this table are one-shots.
